summary.zh-CN: 从检测需求到 Sigma 源规则，再到 Splunk SPL、Sentinel KQL、Elastic EQL 草案、字段映射、样本回放与变更回滚说明；目标引擎验证前一律标注未验证。
summary.en: From detection requirements to Sigma rules, Splunk SPL, Sentinel KQL and Elastic EQL drafts, field mappings, sample replay and change/rollback notes; everything is marked unverified until tested on the target engine.

now.zh-CN: 按威胁与 ATT&CK 编号梳理检测需求与验收判据
now.en: Define detection requirements and acceptance criteria from threats and ATT&CK IDs

now.zh-CN: 编写符合规范的 Sigma 规则
生成 SPL/KQL/EQL 与 Suricata、YARA 草案及字段映射
now.en: Draft SPL/KQL/EQL plus Suricata and YARA rules with field mappings

now.zh-CN: 用正负样本回放调优并写变更与回滚说明
now.en: Tune with positive and negative samples and write change and rollback notes

needs.zh-CN: 目标平台版本与日志字段字典
needs.en: Target platform versions and log field dictionary

needs.zh-CN: 脱敏正负样本与验收阈值
needs.en: Sanitised positive/negative samples and acceptance thresholds

permissions.zh-CN: 只读取字段字典与规则库
permissions.en: Read-only access to field dictionaries and rule repositories

permissions.zh-CN: 需你确认才会做：在生产 SIEM 加载或启用规则、开启阻断
permissions.en: Only with your confirmation: loading or enabling rules in production SIEM or turning on blocking

conditions.zh-CN: 转换结果需在你的目标引擎中验证，推荐用 pySigma 官方后端。
conditions.en: Conversions must be verified on your target engine; pySigma official backends are recommended.
